EverQuest Legends Hotfix Notes- 10/29/2026

General

  • Quests and dialogue in Nektropos Castle have been reworked for clarity and to protect players from being unable to progress.
  • Reduced the respawn timers of Plimptos and Lady Sileniu Everling.
  • The debuffs applied by Alexa Everling during her encounter are now removed from players upon her death.
  • Quests in Nektropos Castle that require you to have an item to progress can now find items that are in Equipment Storage.
